record.field: Cash on delivery: how it works at Vela Tech
No card, no online payment. You pay when the parcel is in your hands.

section.p: Most of our customers prefer to pay in cash, and we think that's fair: you shouldn't pay for something you haven't seen. Here is how an order works.
Add products to your cart and choose home delivery. At the payment step, choose cash on delivery. Your order is confirmed right away.
We pack your order the same or next working day. The courier calls you before coming, usually within 2 to 5 working days.
Open the parcel in front of the courier. If something is wrong, refuse it and pay nothing. If all is good, pay the amount shown on your order, in cash.
Choose pickup in store at checkout and pay at our Tunis counter when you collect.

record.field: Four questions to ask before you spend a semester's budget.

section.p: A student laptop has to last five years, survive a backpack and run whatever your courses throw at it. Start with these questions.
Office work and browsing need little. Programming, data science or design need 16 GB of memory; 3D or video work needs a dedicated graphics card.
section.h2: How much will you carry it?
section.p: Under 1.5 kg and a battery that lasts a full day of lectures matter more than raw power for most students.
512 GB SSD is the comfortable minimum. You can add an external SSD later, but you can rarely upgrade the internal one.
Check what your school uses. Some engineering software only runs on Windows; macOS is common in design.

record.field: A quick guide to choosing what goes in, or over, your ears.

section.p: Both play music. The right one depends on where you listen.
Small, light and pocketable: best for the metro, the gym and calls on the go. Look for a snug fit and water resistance if you sweat.
Bigger drivers and better noise cancelling make them the choice for long study sessions, flights and open offices. Comfort over hours matters more than looks.
If you listen in noisy places, yes: you will keep the volume lower, which your ears will thank you for.
